scope: Accuracy and smooth-stop thresholds apply to the known model-matched process load only; unknown-load error and stop metrics carry no such claim. All three strategies share the physical and public experiment settings except name and their two strategy flags. Both assisted strategies use the same startup settings. The directed static limit Fs determines the model-derived first valve target; the physical valve starts at zero and its homogeneous initial mismatch follows the real actuator pole. The initial command step is recorded separately from subsequent startup smoothness. Continuous release events and sampled velocity thresholds are distinct diagnostics. All retained legacy performance ranges, including max(5*valve_tau, Ts) startup delay and the former one-sample delay, remain reported with actual values, targets and reasons. Default success requires all mechanism and numerical acceptance checks; --strict-reference additionally requires every retained reference target. For quantized bare PID the pointwise convergence bound remains one ADC LSB; assisted groups retain one-quarter LSB. Original quarter results and ADC-code disagreements remain recorded.
